ruleDefinitions.name: LiveKD Driver Creation By Uncommon Process
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation of the LiveKD driver by a process image other than "livekd.exe".

sequences.query: file_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\drivers\\LiveKdD\.SYS" AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\\\livekd\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\livek64\\\.exe$")))
